segments.he: בְּיוֹם שְׁלִישִׁי פָּרָשַׁת צַו חָזַרְתִּי וְשָׁלַחְתִּי עַל יְדֵי הַפָּאסְט אִגֶּרֶת לְרַבִּי יְהוּדָא אֱלִיעֶזֶר שֶׁיָּבוֹא וְעַל כָּל פָּנִים יִשְׁלַח לִי תְּשׁוּבָה הֵן אוֹ לָאו:
segments.en: And my companion Rabbi Naftali and other men were standing before him. And his illness was considerably worse. And Rabbi Naftali told me that he had already gone to call the doctor — and I was very angry at him about this, for my mind was not at all willing in any manner that a doctor be called to him.
